## Story
37fc-6f8d-444d-44bf — As an agent filing a bug automatically, I want detected_by inferred from filing context

## testing_mode: RED

## What to do
Create `tests/scripts/test-infer-detected-by.sh` with exactly 10 test functions:

1. test_mutation_auto_bug_maps_to_tests: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=mutation-auto-bug → outputs "tests"
2. test_fix_bug_phase_g_maps_to_review_llm: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=fix-bug-phase-g → outputs "review-llm"
3. test_debug_everything_maps_to_review_llm: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=debug-everything → outputs "review-llm"
4. test_review_human_maps_to_review_human: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=review-human → outputs "review-human"
5. test_production_maps_to_production: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=production → outputs "production"
6. test_user_report_maps_to_user_report: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=user-report → outputs "user-report"
7. test_internal_dogfood_maps_to_internal_dogfood: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=internal-dogfood → outputs "internal-dogfood"
8. test_empty_context_maps_to_other: unset DSO_FILING_CONTEXT → outputs "other" (exit 0)
9. test_unknown_context_maps_to_other: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=garbage → outputs "other" (exit 0)
10. test_script_is_executable: `test -x plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh` passes

Tests 1–9 must FAIL (script missing) when task-1 commits alone. Test 10 must FAIL too (script missing).
The test file itself must be executable (chmod +x).

## Verify
Run: bash tests/run-all.sh --runner=bash --test-file=tests/scripts/test-infer-detected-by.sh
Expected: all 10 tests FAIL RED (infer-detected-by.sh does not exist yet)

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: test file exists at tests/scripts/test-infer-detected-by.sh and is executable
- dd-5: test suite contains at least 7 assertions (one per allowed value)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File created at tests/scripts/test-infer-detected-by.sh
- [ ] File is executable (chmod +x applied)
- [ ] Contains exactly 10 test functions per spec above
- [ ] All tests fail RED before task-2 merges (expected)
- [ ] Lint: ruff check passes (no Python files modified)

comments.body:
AC Amendment (gap analysis): 
1. Each test function MUST run the script in an isolated environment. Use a subshell or  to prevent DSO_FILING_CONTEXT from leaking between tests. Example: `result=$(env -i DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=mutation-auto-bug bash plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh)`. test_empty_context_maps_to_other MUST explicitly unset DSO_FILING_CONTEXT or use `env -i bash plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh`.
2. All output comparisons MUST use command substitution: `[ "$(env -i ... bash plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh)" = "tests" ]`. Do NOT use diff or grep-based comparison — command substitution strips trailing newlines, avoiding format mismatches.
3. Invoke the script via the relative path `plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh` (same resolution context as callers in SKILL.md), not a hardcoded absolute path.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC Amendment applied: env isolation + command substitution comparison required. See gap analysis findings 1 and 2.
